title: sokf harness hook answer
description: A `HookAnswer` is the answer that `sokf harness hook claude stop` prints on stdout, and that Codex and Factory Droid read in the same form: an empty object lets the agent stop, and a block makes the agent continue (CLI-3_AC-25, CLI-3_AC-26). Every other harness reads the answer in its own form.

anyOf.description: When errors remain, the agent continues with the reason as its input.

reason.description: The reason starts with `sokf:` and the number of remaining errors. It then lists the fixes that `validate --fix` made, and the errors as `validate` reports them.

anyOf.description: When no error remains, or the hook has already blocked on the same report, the agent stops.

Decision.description: A `Decision` tells Claude Code what to do with the agent. Its only value, `block`, makes the agent continue.
